vulnerability_title: Inverted sign convention for amountSpecified breaks swap logic

content_code_consistency.content_reasoning: _executeBuy and _executeSell treat a positive amountSpecified as exact input and a negative one as exact output. Uniswap V4 uses the opposite convention, so the returned deltas are swapped.

scsvs_classification.vulnerability_type: inverted exact-input and exact-output sign convention
